from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/infcover.c","function":"cover_fast","line":653,"var":"hex input","code":"inf(\"d c7 1 ae eb 38 c 4 41 a0 87 72 de df fb 1f b8 36 b1 38 5d ff ff 0\", \"fast 2nd level codes and too far back\", 0, -8, 258, Z_DATA_ERROR);","note":"This candidate feeds a crafted deflate stream intended to reach the fast decoder and exercise a back-reference path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/infcover.c","function":"h2b","line":245,"var":"in","code":"in = malloc((strlen(hex) + 1) >> 1); ... decode hex pairs into bytes","note":"The textual hex payload is converted into the raw attacker-controlled byte buffer passed to inflate()."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/infcover.c","function":"inf","line":293,"var":"strm.next_in / strm.avail_in","code":"mem_setup(&strm); ... strm.avail_in = step; strm.next_in = in;","note":"The decoded bytes are installed as the z_stream input before decompression begins."},
  {"step":4,"file":"inflate.c","function":"inflate","line":0,"var":"state->mode","code":"inflate() parses the stream and advances into LEN decoding, where inflate_fast() is used when enough input/output is available.","note":"Execution reaches the fast literal/length and distance decoder on the attacker-controlled data."},
  {"step":5,"file":"inffast.c","function":"inflate_fast","line":120,"var":"len","code":"here = lcode[hold & lmask]; ... if (op & 16) { len = (unsigned)(here.val); ... }","note":"The crafted literal/length code produces a match length for a back-reference copy."},
  {"step":6,"file":"inffast.c","function":"inflate_fast","line":145,"var":"dist","code":"here = dcode[hold & dmask]; ... dist += (unsigned)hold & ((1U << op) - 1);","note":"The crafted distance code produces a backward distance that is larger than the available history/output window."},
  {"step":7,"file":"inffast.c","function":"inflate_fast","line":173,"var":"state->sane / strm->msg","code":"if (op > whave) { if (state->sane) { strm->msg = \"invalid distance too far back\"; state->mode = BAD; break; } }","note":"The root cause is the invalid-distance check; with sane mode enabled, the decoder rejects the out-of-range back-reference instead of copying from invalid memory."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print(p.read_text())
